reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream needs handoff and maps exact need text to the provided capabilities. The observed coverage correctly leaves n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported and marks n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r06, and n06-r08 as direct.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact upstream handoff records and allowed record identifiers
avoid generic keyword matching by requiring exact need-to-capability matches
keep missing or uncovered needs visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts unsupported semantics by setting unsupported true when coverage == 'direct'. This ranks covered needs ahead of genuinely unsupported needs and causes the final recommendation to prioritize n06-r02 instead of the highest-ranked uncovered demand n06-r01.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each support group
preserve visible distinction between observed coverage and prioritization status

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-item priority window and deterministically builds the recommendation from the first priority row. The bad recommendation is inherited from the faulty priority ordering, not introduced here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record
produce behaviorally correct recommendation when upstream priorities are correct

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records selects all supplied corpus rows because each record has demand_score >= 3, preserving the explicit fallback path for n06-r07 and n06-r08. The supplied package does not include underlying market-observation evidence, so customer-demand validity beyond the provided corpus cannot be independently judged.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: select demanded corpus rows using the declared threshold and fallback path
establish real market demand from observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence preserves the bounded allowed-record window n06-r01 through n06-r08, applies JSON-safe defaults, coerces numeric fields, and emits the eight normalized needs used by the downstream handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: normalize selected evidence to the bounded allowed-record window
avoid adding unsupported or unrelated candidate records

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance ranks the normalized needs by descending demand_score with record_id tie-breaks, producing the evidence_sources handoff observed by the downstream job. No contradiction is visible in the supplied upstream output.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: build ranked evidence-source provenance records from normalized needs
avoid treating repeated history as independent corroboration
